dict.string: Rookery takes over the sound of the applications you choose, so its mixer can adjust their volume, stereo, equalizer and reverb.
Rookery asks Mail to put a draft you approved in front of you, in the account you chose, and reads which accounts Mail holds. It never sends mail.
Rookery reads your calendars, every account's, so Raven can tell you what is on, and changes an event only when you approve it.
